name: VenO (Venetoclax + Obinutuzumab), fixed duration

institution.provenance: DRAFT decision-support protocol authored from standard-of-care dosing (experimental; owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

premedications.name: Obinutuzumab infusion-reaction prophylaxis
premedications.notes: corticosteroid, antihistamine and antipyretic before the infusion; split the first dose over two days to reduce reactions.

premedications.name: Tumor-lysis-syndrome prophylaxis
premedications.notes: hydration and a uric-acid-lowering agent (allopurinol, or rasburicase for high risk) around the venetoclax ramp-up; risk-stratify by tumor burden and renal function.

supportiveCare: Fixed-duration, chemotherapy-free course: obinutuzumab for 6 cycles and venetoclax for about 12 months total.
Mandatory tumor-lysis-syndrome risk assessment with hydration and the weekly venetoclax ramp-up before the 400 mg target dose.
Hepatitis B reactivation prophylaxis if HBcAb-positive (anti-CD20 antibody).
Antiviral and PJP prophylaxis per risk.
monitoring: Tumor-lysis labs (potassium, phosphate, calcium, uric acid, creatinine) during each venetoclax step-up, per a defined schedule
Infusion-reaction monitoring, chiefly with the first obinutuzumab dose

doseModificationRules.condition: laboratory or clinical tumor lysis during ramp-up
doseModificationRules.text: Hold venetoclax, treat the metabolic abnormality, and resume the ramp-up per standard practice; physician decides.

drugs.name: Obinutuzumab
drugs.notes: Standard dosing (NCCN / DeVita, general reference): 1000 mg IV per dose. Cycle 1 gives the first 1000 mg split as 100 mg on day 1 and 900 mg on day 2 to limit infusion reactions, then 1000 mg on days 8 and 15; cycles 2 to 6 give 1000 mg on day 1 only. dosePerUnit is the 1000 mg unit dose; days shown are the cycle-1 schedule. Own wording; not copied from any source.

drugs.name: Venetoclax
drugs.notes: Standard dosing (NCCN / DeVita, general reference): oral daily, started as a 5-week ramp-up (20 mg, then 50, 100, 200, 400 mg, escalating weekly) to reduce tumor-lysis risk, then 400 mg once daily continued to complete about 12 months of therapy. dosePerUnit is the 400 mg target maintenance dose; the ramp-up steps are given in the notes. Own wording; not copied from any source.
